mapper.select: SELECT vin, model_code, status, execution_id, reason, requested_at, updated_at FROM vin_registrations WHERE vin = #{vin}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vin_registrations (vin, model_code, status, execution_id, requested_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{vin}, #{modelCode}, #{status}, #{executionId}, #{requestedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE vin_registrations SET status = #{status}, reason = #{reason}, updated_at = now() WHERE vin = #{vin}
